showcaseArticle.title: Vacanza 101: How to travel without paying for accommodation
showcaseArticle.description:
Vacanza is the **first Greek platform** that brings to Greece exclusively the home exchange model. It has been proved to be very successful in other countries of Europe mainly for traveling without paying for accommodation, but also for forming bonds with new people.

It is an alternative to the ordinary booking sites in which you pay your money for accommodation, and you don't know the other person and the current situation of the house before traveling.

 Also, the host does not know what kind of person you are, and many times cannot cancel your booking without a penalty. This can leave both the hosts and guests dissatisfied and potential damages to the property.

Vacanza on the contrary is based on open communication and choosing a travel partner that is compatible with your needs and priorities, without paying your money for accommodation.

All our users and properties undergo a verification process with regular checks, in order to keep the community safe. If you want maximum safety, you can also follow our [safety guidelines](/articles/2).

## You Decide!

One of the most important things of Vacanza is that **YOU decide** when to make your house available (through the availability calendar), and you decide who to accept in your house, after having communicated with them. If you are compatible you can proceed to exchange and enjoy your free vacation!

### Who Can Benefit:

Vacanza can be beneficial for:
- **Homeowners** who want to go on vacation without paying for accommodation.
- **Homeowners** who want to travel with a different experience.
- **Homeowners** with unused houses.
- **Tenants**, who already pay rent and do not want to pay (or cannot pay) big sums of money to go on vacation. In this case tenants should check with their homeowner that it can be allowed.
- **Homeowners** who have an investment house on traditional booking sites - making the house available only when they want to go on vacation, then put it back for profit later.
- **Families** - who have different needs from other people, and can find other families on the platform to exchange.
- **Digital nomads** searching for a house in Greece, without having to deal with agencies and extra costs.
- **Solo travelers, Couples, Single women, Retirees** - Each of you have different priorities and needs, and through the platform you can find compatible people that have the same priorities and needs as you.

### How It Works

As it is also in other countries, Vacanza offers the opportunity to make **simultaneous exchanges** (exchange houses at the same time), or **non-simultaneous exchanges** (for example, Maria goes to Giorgos house now, and Giorgos will go to Maria next month). This allows for the maximum flexibility between the two people's schedules.

Also, at Vacanza we are constantly working with other companies, including car rental companies, insurances, flight companies and more, in order to give you the most affordable way of traveling beyond accommodation as well.

This model will allow also to keep a more sustainable economy and environment, and a sense of community, giving value also to small centers in Greece and discovering places that you didn’t know existed.

secondArticle.title: How to ensure the safest home exchange (Safety Guidelines)
secondArticle.description:
Your vacation should be as safe as possible, so you can truly enjoy it, relax, and have fun. In this article, you’ll find the essential guidelines to ensure the safest home exchange experience.

Some of our users complete 10, 20, or even 50 exchanges per year — but we understand that the very first time you consider leaving your home to someone else can feel overwhelming. That’s why we’re here: to provide you with all the information you need to feel completely secure.

## The foundation of our system: User verification

Users with fully verified profiles receive the Verified badge and are easily recognizable across the platform.

In addition:
- Every user and every property has public reviews
- Reviews add an extra layer of transparency and trust

After reaching a certain number of successful exchanges and positive reviews, users earn special badges such as Golden Host and Golden Guest, indicating experience and reliability.

## Practical safety guidelines

To maximize safety, we recommend:
- Taking photos of your home before and after the exchange
- Avoiding leaving valuable items in your home while you’re away
- Always communicating through the platform chat, so everything is written and recorded
- If you meet in person or via video call, writing a recap afterwards for clarity
- Defining the house rules in advance and keeping them in written form (for a complete exchange etiquette guide, read our other articles)
- Signal users who have fraudulent or strange behaviour (asking for money to exchange, being threatening, not being clear on important aspects). We will do checks on them.

> We actively investigate such cases. Users considered a risk to the community are permanently banned from the platform.

## Additional protection through insurance

Lastly, to add even more safety, we collaborate with insurance companies in order to give you the best product possible tailored to your needs, and cover for possible damages, theft and more. This has a separate cost, and is not mandatory, but you can do it if you want to be 100% safe and sound.

**Join Vacanza today!**

thirdArticle.title: The 4 types of exchange
thirdArticle.description:
Discover all the types of exchange available in Vacanza and choose the one you prefer.
You can also choose multiple ones, depending on your needs at the moment.

### 1. Simultaneous exchange
This is the classic and most common type of exchange.

I come to your house in Crete, and you come to my house in Athens.

We both enjoy our stay, make new friends, gain new experiences, and return home full of joy and satisfaction, (and with some extra euros saved). 

We also keep in touch, in case I want to come back to Crete again in the future.

### 2. Non-simultaneous exchange
With this type of exchange, stays do not happen at the same time.

You can come to Athens now (for example, while I am on a business trip), and I will come to Crete at a later time, when your house becomes available.

### 3. Co-living
In a co-living exchange, you can stay in my house while I am also living there.

For example, you may have an exam tomorrow and need a spare room, while I am busy working.
Don’t worry — we both follow our daily routines, and if we want, we can also spend some time together.

### 4. Non-reciprocal exchange
In this case, only one person stays at the partner’s house, without offering their own home in return.

This is not a traditional exchange, but we mention it for flexibility and additional possibilities.

> This type can be very useful for **pet-sitting**.
> A pet sitter can stay in your home free of charge, take care of your pets, and enjoy accommodation at no cost for the agreed period.

Feel free to communicate openly with your exchange partner and choose the type that suits you both best.

**Join Vacanza today!**

fourthArticle.title: How to create attractive listings (RESERVED TO MEMBERS)
fourthArticle.description:
To increase your chances of successful exchanges, it’s essential to build trust with people who view your profile and properties.

Start by completing your profile verification until it reaches **100%**.

For your properties, follow the best practices below to attract more requests.

## Guidelines for attractive listings

- **High-quality photos.**
   Show the spaces in a functional and aesthetic manner without unnecessary clutter. Make people imagine to “enter the photo” and be there.

- **Complete and detailed description of the place.**
  Include: amenities, rules of the house, eventual problems that they may encounter. People will appreciate transparency and clarity.

- **Highlight the best features of the place,**
  both in photos and in the description.

- **Highlight the location of the property.**
 What are the positive aspects? How well is it connected with transportation and key points (airport, port, train stations, public transports, sea or mountains, touristic sites, museums)? Clear indications are considered a plus. 

- **Highlight local services.**
 and their distance from the place (supermarkets, minimarkets, pharmacies, banks etc) 

- **Describe the neighborhood.**
  Is it safe? Is it quiet? Central?.

- **Highlight relevant activities in the area,**
  if there are any. Some people do not only look for relaxation but also for activities. Some examples are: horse riding, hiking paths, surfing clubs, sailing, skiing, natural and thermal springs, cultural experiences etc. The same can be done with famous local events, local food and your favourite places to visit.

- **Be specific about pets and children.**
  Can your place welcome them or not?

- **Avoid hiding things.**
 On the contrary, people will be frustrated and disappointed if you omit important details, leaving room for bad reviews and no second exchanges with the same person.

These guidelines are nothing without the proper communication though. Communicate always in a friendly, transparent and polite manner.

**Join Vacanza today!**

fifthArticle.title:
Etiquette:
(RESERVED TO MEMBERS)
fifthArticle.description:
Exchanging houses is fun and cost-free, but it is mandatory to respect each other's rules, establishing them beforehand.

We encourage you to be respectful and polite of each other’s needs, in order to ensure the best vacation possible for all the people involved.

We also remind you that it is prohibited to ask for money for the exchange. In case this happens, kindly report it to us.

Some guidelines for best practices involve:

- **Friendly behaviour, respect, politeness**
- **Be honest and transparent about your property** (location, amenities etc)
- **Avoid copy paste and personalize your messages**
- **Remove all the personal items in the house** (e.g. family photos) in order to make the guest feel more welcomed and not like an “intruder” in your house
- **Communicate about what objects to bring eventually, and what is already in the house** (eg. you want to bring your own bedsheets, towels, kitchen utensils etc. or not?)
- **Put in writing the basics** (password of the WIFI, how to use kitchen and bathroom appliances etc).
- **Communicate about where to leave the keys** (eg. inside the house if you have a backup key; to a local shop that you trust: to a friend; to a local online service etc.- Or you can exchange them in person if you want).
- **Want to save the cost of car rental as well?** You can also exchange your cars if you want to.
- **Be clear about the rules in the beginning, but don’t be constantly pressing during the stay.** Enjoy and let the other person enjoy the stay.
- **Be available in case the other person needs suggestions about the place** (where to eat, what to do at night, which museums to visit etc).
- **In case something breaks, report it immediately and communicate on the solution**, based on the urgency. You can always get tailored insurance if you want to be fully covered.
- **In case something very serious happens and you must cancel the exchange**, let your partner know in time, or if it’s too last minute, try to find an alternative accommodation for them.
- **When you leave the house, leave it in pristine and clean condition** as it was yours. You can also make professional cleaners come if you don’t want to clean yourself, if the host agrees.
- **It’s always nice to make gifts to the other person** to thank them for the hospitality, if you want.
- **After the exchange, you can stay in touch with your new friends**, and organize another exchange with them if you want to!

Following these simple guidelines, you will ensure the best vacation for yourself and for your family.

To ensure the maximum safety of your exchange and fully enjoy your stay, you can also read all the safety guidelines [Here](/articles/2).

**Join Vacanza today!**

tenthArticle.title: Discover the World Differently: How Retirees Travel with Vacanza
tenthArticle.description:
Retirement is a time to finally live life on your own terms. To explore, to connect, and to savor new experiences without the constraints of work schedules. But travel can be expensive, and traditional accommodations often eat up a big part of any budget. That’s why more and more retirees are turning to home exchange and platforms like Vacanza are making it easier, safer, and more rewarding than ever.

**Travel Without the Price Tag**

With Vacanza, you can explore every corner of Greece without paying for hotels or rentals. Instead, you swap homes with other members for a chosen period.

Imagine spending a week in a cozy house in Nafplio, a month by the sea in Crete, or escaping to a quiet stone village in Epirus. All while your own home welcomes another traveler eager to experience your region.

For retirees comfort matters, and Vacanza offers exactly that. You’ll have all the conveniences of a real home: a kitchen to cook in, a garden to enjoy, and perhaps even a friendly neighbor to share a coffee with.

Even better, Vacanza is built around a trust-based community. Every member is verified, and profiles include reviews, photos, and personal messages, so you always know who you’re exchanging with. Many retirees discover not just new destinations, but new friendships along the way.

**A Simple Yearly Membership. Unlimited Possibilities**

Unlike pay-per-stay platforms, Vacanza operates on a flat yearly subscription. One simple membership gives you unlimited exchanges throughout the year. That means you can travel as often as you like, from quick weekend breaks to long-term stays, with no extra booking costs.

For retirees who love to travel frequently or enjoy seasonal getaways, that’s incredible value.

Vacanza isn’t just about saving money, it’s about traveling like a local and rediscovering the beauty of your own country. You’ll stay in authentic Greek homes, shop at local markets, and connect with fellow travelers who share your love for Greek culture and hospitality.

Whether you live in Athens, Thessaloniki, or a small island village, Vacanza opens the door to a richer, more personal way to experience Greece, comfortably, safely, and affordably.

Join thousands of like-minded travelers who have discovered the freedom of home exchange.
With Vacanza, your home becomes your ticket to the world.

**Join Vacanza Today**

eleventhArticle.title: Why Vacanza Is the Future of Sustainable Travel
eleventhArticle.description:
A rising importance nowadays should be given to the topic of sustainability of the local economy and environment, and to eco-friendly solutions.

Firstly, Vacanza aligns with eco-conscious travel habits, reduces carbon footprint, and has way less resource use compared to hotels and hospitality structures.

Also, a special focus is given to small local communities, supporting slow travel and deep cultural experiences, allowing you to discover new things about this country.

You probably have noticed that the properties that you find on traditional sites are also somewhat uniform and follow a precise trend and aesthetic, not aligning with local communities and culture. With Vacanza you don't have to appeal to a specific market, nor stress about strategies to maximize the revenue.

Lastly, being a non-speculative way of travel it has a minimal impact on the local housing market, compared with short term rentals (e.g. BnB) that have vastly populated the centers making the prices of houses skyrocket.
This situation created a ban in the historical center of Athens in 2025, where it is not possible to create other BnBs, in an attempt to stop the rising inflation (the rise in prices of housing and goods).

In conclusion, not only Vacanza offers a more eco-friendly approach to traveling, but also can help the people that live in Greece find houses to rent or buy in the long term, potentially slowing down the inflation and the rise in prices.

fourteenthArticle.title: Make New Friends with Vacanza
fourteenthArticle.description:
While traveling or working, you can make friends in different places and establish new connections!

Sometimes, being in a foreign place where you don’t know local people can be lonely.

That’s what Vacanza is also for.

Because there's another, deeper reward that many don’t expect until they experience it firsthand: **the friendships and human connections that naturally grow from sharing homes and lives, even for a short time.**

**The Greek Spirit of Filoxenia: More Than Just Hospitality**

In Greece, hospitality isn’t just a nicety. It’s a way of life. The ancient concept of filoxenia translates to “friend to a stranger,” and it's still deeply woven into the culture today. When you exchange homes with someone in Greece, you’re not just borrowing a space, you’re stepping into a story, a neighborhood, and often, into someone’s community.

Whether you're swapping homes in Athens, a seaside village in the Peloponnese, or a tucked-away island like Amorgos, **you're entering a world where connections matter.** You might be greeted with fresh fruit from a neighbor’s garden, or receive insider tips on the best local taverna. Many exchangers find that these moments lead to real friendships that last long after the trip ends.

**Vacanza: A Natural Bridge Between People**

Unlike hotels or short-term rentals, Vacanza invites trust, communication, and mutual respect from the very beginning. It starts with messaging, sharing family details, and perhaps even a video call. You’re not just booking a place—you’re **building a friendship.**

These bonds often extend beyond the initial exchange:

- Families stay in touch and plan future swaps.
- Guests become pen pals, sharing recipes or photos.
- Hosts introduce visitors to friends or family in the area.
- Some exchangers even meet in person to hand over keys or welcome one another.

It’s not uncommon for a simple exchange to evolve into a **global friendship network**—a modern twist on an ancient Greek value.

**The Real Perks of Human Connection**

While travel offers sights and experiences, **connections offer meaning.** When you make friends through a home exchange, the benefits go far beyond accommodation:

- **Authentic travel:** Friends guide you to experiences off the tourist path.
- **Cultural learning:** Conversations over coffee often teach more than a guidebook ever could.
- **A sense of belonging:** Being invited to a name-day celebration or a beach picnic can turn a trip into a memory you’ll cherish forever.
- **Travel support:** Whether it's getting help with a ferry ticket or borrowing beach gear, having local allies makes travel smoother and more relaxed.

**A Travel Community, Not Just a Platform**

At its best, Vacanza isn’t a booking platform—it’s a **community of like-minded travelers** who value trust, friendship, and meaningful experiences. In Greece, where every corner is steeped in history, beauty, and warmth, this community thrives.

If you’re considering a home exchange in Greece, go in with an open heart. The greatest gift you might take home isn’t a ceramic dish or bottle of olive oil—but a **friendship that spans borders.**

Ready to make your next adventure more personal, more authentic, and more connected? **Join Vacanza today** and discover the joy of traveling not just to places, but to people.
